title: Amazon S3 permits same-day lifecycle transitions to Standard-IA and One Zone-IA
summary: S3 Lifecycle configurations can now transition new objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access or S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access without first retaining them in S3 Standard for 30 days.
why_it_matters: Teams can move immediately cold backups, logs, and compliance objects into an infrequent-access class while keeping the lifecycle policy declarative.
caveats: Standard-IA and One Zone-IA still have minimum billable object-size and storage-duration rules.
One Zone-IA stores data in one Availability Zone and is inappropriate when multi-AZ resilience is required.
A cost model should include retrieval charges, object size, retention, and access frequency before adoption.
adoption_question: Which object prefixes become cold on creation, and do their size, retrieval, resilience, and retention characteristics make an immediate IA transition cheaper?

sources.title: Amazon S3 removes 30-day minimum storage duration for lifecycle transitions to S3 Standard-IA and S3 One Zone-IA

example_reason: A mocked Terraform test can prove that a zero-day transition is represented without calling AWS.
